description: Introducing the sleek and eco-friendly 2015 Ford Focus Electric, a cutting-edge vehicle that combines impressive performance with sustainable technology. This electric marvel is powered by a robust Electric 143hp 184ft. lbs. engine, offering a smooth and quiet ride while minimizing environmental impact. With a striking Gray exterior and a luxurious Tan interior, this Ford Focus Electric is sure to turn heads wherever you go.  One of the standout features of this 2015 Ford Focus Electric is its exceptional mileage. With less than 78,000 miles on the odometer and averaging less than 8,000 miles per year, this vehicle has plenty of life left to offer its next owner. The fact that it has had just one previous owner speaks to the care and attention it has received since leaving the factory.  Now, let's delve into the factory default features that come standard with this remarkable Ford Focus Electric. Starting with the exterior, this model is equipped with automatic halogen headlamps that provide excellent visibility in all driving conditions. The distinctive front grille proudly displays the iconic Ford logo, while the aerodynamic design enhances both performance and efficiency.  Moving to the interior, the Tan upholstery adds a touch of sophistication to the cabin, creating a welcoming and comfortable environment for both the driver and passengers. The front seats are not only stylish but also power-adjustable, allowing for personalized comfort on every journey. The leather-wrapped steering wheel feels great in hand and features integrated audio and cruise controls for added convenience.  Technological innovation is at the forefront of the 2015 Ford Focus Electric, with features like the SYNC infotainment system. This intuitive system includes a touchscreen display, Bluetooth connectivity, and voice recognition, keeping you connected and entertained on the road.
